subject.title: [Feature]: Clickable file links in chat with file viewer sidebar; workspace navigator previews any in-root file

question: Should sessions.files.get be allowed to serve any fs-safe in-root workspace file for Control UI previews under operator.read, or should preview remain transcript-touched or move to a narrower/new workspace-read contract?
rationale: Source inspection confirms the requested behavior is missing, but the backend change would alter a file-content authorization boundary and the live issue has the protected maintainer label.

options.title: Approve bounded in-root reads
options.body: Accept the linked PR direction after its correctness blockers are fixed and document or test that operator.read intentionally covers these workspace file contents.

options.title: Keep transcript-touched reads
options.body: Preserve the current narrower sessions.files.get contract and ask for chat-link or browser behavior that does not expose arbitrary in-root file contents.

options.title: Split a new workspace-read API
options.body: Keep this issue open while designing a separate explicit workspace-read method with its own authorization and audit posture.

recommendation.title: Approve bounded in-root reads
recommendation.body: Accept the linked PR direction after its correctness blockers are fixed and document or test that operator.read intentionally covers these workspace file contents.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete opened the protected feature request and the paired PR, and CONTRIBUTING.md identifies Peter Steinberger as the relevant product-direction authority.
